title: Student Tour
description: A philosophy professor (Charles Butterworth) accompanies his school's rowing team on a worldwide tour.

title: Spring Madness
description: A student from a nearby women's college falls for a Harvard man set on a postgraduate two-year tour of Russia with his roommate.

title: She's Working Her Way Through College
description: A burlesque queen (Virginia Mayo) goes to college, charms a professor (Ronald Reagan) and livens up the class play.

title: Freshman Love
description: A crew coach (Frank McHugh) uses the college president's daughter (Patricia Ellis) to recruit top oarsmen.

title: Girl Crazy
description: A publisher's playboy son (Mickey Rooney) falls for the dean's granddaughter (Judy Garland) at an all-male mining school.

title: College Coach
description: A tough football coach (Pat O'Brien) takes his team and its singing star (Dick Powell) to the big game.

title: Too Many Girls
description: An heiress (Lucille Ball) attends a Southwest college with four football-star bodyguards hired by her father.

title: Latin Lovers
description: A rich girl (Lana Turner) follows her rich boyfriend (John Lund) to Brazil, where she flirts with a rich rancher (Ricardo Montalban).

title: Madame X
description: A young lawyer (Keir Dullea) defends an alcoholic woman (Lana Turner) accused of murder, unaware that she is his mother.

title: Sayonara
description: An American jet ace has a poignant affair with the star performer of a famed Japanese acting company.

title: The Reluctant Saint
description: An inept young priest-in-training is declared a saint when he begins floating about the monastery during prayer service.

title: Sombrero
description: Mexican love stories follow a dying man, a bullfighter's sister (Cyd Charisse) and lovers (Ricardo Montalban, Pier Angeli) from feuding villages.

title: Wyoming
description: An outlaw (Wallace Beery) leaves Missouri with his partner (Leo Carrillo) and reforms for children and a blacksmith (Marjorie Main).

title: Parachute Jumper
description: A Marine pilot (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.), his buddy and their girlfriend (Bette Davis) go to work for a gangster (Leo Carrillo).

title: The Band Plays On
description: A judge hands four wayward boys to a college football coach, who turns them into backfield stars.

title: The Winning Ticket
description: When a man wins the Irish Sweepstakes, he realizes that he cannot claim the prize until he locates his ticket.

title: In Caliente
description: A critic (Pat O'Brien) goes to a Mexican resort and meets a dancer (Dolores del Río) he had given a bad review.

title: The Girl of the Golden West
description: A lovesick sheriff (Walter Pidgeon) competes with a Mexican bandit (Nelson Eddy) for a mining-town saloon keeper (Jeanette MacDonald).

title: Moonlight Murder
description: An amateur detective gets a chance to test his sleuthing skills when an opera singer is murdered at the Hollywood Bowl.

title: The Gay Bride
description: A gorgeous chorus girl determined to marry into money finds one wealthy beau after another while a handsome bodyguard remains devoted, hoping to win her heart.

title: The Gay Desperado
description: An opera tenor (Nino Martini) and an heiress (Ida Lupino) are kidnapped by a Mexican bandit (Leo Carrillo) who likes gangster movies.

title: Against All Flags
description: A British naval officer (Errol Flynn) poses as a deserter to trick a pirate (Maureen O'Hara) and her cohort (Anthony Quinn) in 1700 Madagascar.

title: The Crimson Pirate
description: An acrobatic pirate (Burt Lancaster) and his sidekick (Nick Cravat) help Caribbean rebels fight Spain with an inventor's weapons.

title: Moonfleet
description: In the 18th century, British youngster John Mohune is shipped off to live with Jeremy Fox, a gentleman who moonlights as a bootlegger, after his mother's death.

title: Cyrano de Bergerac
description: Long-nosed Cyrano (Jose Ferrer) loves fair Roxane (Mala Powers) but woos her with verse for a tongue-tied friend (William Prince).

title: The Master of Ballantrae
description: Two Scottish brothers engage in fierce sibling rivalry while battling pirates, Indians and British soldiers.

title: Ivanhoe
description: Back from a Crusade, the knight hero (Robert Taylor) of Sir Walter Scott's novel fights for courtly love and Saxon honor.

title: Scaramouche
description: An 18th-century Frenchman (Stewart Granger) poses as a clown and meets a master swordsman in a duel of revenge.

title: Quentin Durward
description: Sir Walter Scott's Scottish Guard hero (Robert Taylor) foils Louis XI (Robert Morley) and wins Countess Isabelle (Kay Kendall) in 15th-century France.

title: Fanfan la Tulipe
description: An 18th-century French swashbuckler joins the king's army to evade a forced marriage.

title: The Bad and the Beautiful
description: A ruthless producer (Kirk Douglas) uses and discards Hollywood hopefuls as stepping stones to the top of the Tinseltown heap.

title: The Legend of Lylah Clare
description: A filmmaker manipulates a starlet into the image of his late wife, a celebrated actress who met a tragic death.

title: Untamed Youth
description: Vagrant sisters (Mamie Van Doren, Lori Nelson) work for crooked characters at a rock 'n' roll prison-farm.

title: Teenage Doll
description: After killing a member of a teenage gang in a fight over her boyfriend, a girl seeks the protection of his gang.

title: The Graduate
description: An aimless college man (Dustin Hoffman) lets an older woman (Anne Bancroft) seduce him, then finds himself falling for her daughter (Katharine Ross).

title: The Miracle Worker
description: Teacher Anne Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) leads deaf and blind Helen Keller (Patty Duke) out of darkness.

title: The Pumpkin Eater
description: A Londoner (Anne Bancroft) with several children leaves her second husband for a screenwriter (Peter Finch), who fools around.

title: The Prisoner of Second Avenue
description: An advertising executive loses his job and his sanity because of the recession and the hectic pace of Manhattan life.

title: The Sunshine Boys
description: After a long separation, two former vaudeville partners reunite to renew their friendship and their feud.

title: Arena
description: Left by his wife (Polly Bergen), a vain rodeo star (Gig Young) picks up a floozy (Jean Hagen) and rides a bad Brahman bull.

title: Banjo
description: A Georgia orphan (Sharyn Moffett) and her dog, Banjo, go to live with her Boston aunt (Jacqueline White), who sends Banjo back.

title: Child of Divorce
description: The divorce of her parents (Regis Toomey, Madge Meredith) breaks a little girl's (Sharyn Moffett) heart.

title: Bodyguard
description: An ousted Los Angeles homicide detective (Lawrence Tierney) goes to work for a widow and is framed for murder.

title: Trapped
description: An ex-counterfeiter (Lloyd Bridges) leads an undercover agent (John Hoyt) to a gang using his best plates.

title: Follow Me Quietly
description: A police detective (William Lundigan) and a newswoman (Dorothy Patrick) hunt a rainy-day strangler dubbed the Judge.

title: Armored Car Robbery
description: A Los Angeles policeman (Charles McGraw) hunts the mastermind (William Talman) of a theft gang that killed his partner.

title: The Narrow Margin
description: Hit men board a train to kill a racketeer's widow (Marie Windsor) escorted by a Los Angeles detective (Charles McGraw).

title: The Last Run
description: A retired mob getaway driver (George C. Scott) agrees to take a fugitive (Tony Musante) across the Spanish border to France.

title: Soylent Green
description: Future New Yorkers live on a trademarked food, which two detectives (Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson) find has a secret ingredient.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description: Supercomputer HAL 9000 guides astronauts (Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester) on a trip to find the origins of humans.
